scope: Independent static review and exact shell/decompression roundtrip; no reviewer phone execution. Parent retains the recent no-live-QEMU observation.
verified: Root and canonical existing preparation/receipt directories required.
Existing ordinary owner.lock opened without following symlinks and acquired nonblocking exclusively; retained across whole operation.
New firstboot owner/work/receipt/log/attempt/checkpoint must remain absent before and after sync.
Skip when observed MemAvailable already meets unchanged4026531840-byte launch floor.
Exclusive receipt reserves a single operation; no loop or overwrite of earlier evidence.
Only cache mutation is sync then one checked two-byte write of3 newline to canonical /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches.
No process termination, manual thaw, persistent policy change, permission change or retry through access denial.
Original input inode/device/size/mtime identity and global oom_kill readings are compared and logged before/after.
Exceptions are logged and propagated while descriptors release the prep lock; permission denial is not bypassed.

kernel_source.summary: Kernel documentation describes value3 as dropping clean page cache and reclaimable slab; dirty objects are not freed. Prior sync increases eligible clean objects. Cache rebuilding can cost I/O and CPU, so this is a one-time debugging operation, not a persistent cache policy.

limits: The lock and absence checks alone are not a process inventory; parent separately observed no matching live VM/owner before considering this action.
Stat identity checks are metadata checks, not whole-file content hashes.
System-wide memory or OOM counter changes can include unrelated activity; a gain or unchanged counter is not guaranteed.
This review does not establish execution, successful reclamation, new boot or checkpoint.
